title: The Mega‑Earth That Isn't a Super‑Jupiter

scenes.text: A planet 23 times Earth’s mass was spotted orbiting a nearby star
People think any world that massive must be a gas giant like Jupiter
scenes.label: Massive = Gas Giant

scenes.text: The newly confirmed ‘mega‑Earth’ is a solid, rocky world—its density shows it’s made mostly of silicate rock, not hydrogen‑helium gas
scenes.label: Rocky Mega‑Earth

scenes.text: Size alone doesn’t decide composition—density does
scenes.label: SIZE ≠ COMPOSITION

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: A newly discovered super‑massive rocky planet shatters the myth that all huge worlds are gas giants. Follow for daily science!
